en.headline: Theme park performer Bernice Yuen crowned Miss Hong Kong 2026
en.dek: The 26-year-old Baptist University graduate won Sunday night's TVB final at Tseung Kwan O, with Ada Tang and Scarlett Li named first and second runners-up.
body: Bernice Yuen Sze-hang was crowned Miss Hong Kong 2026 at the 54th pageant final on Sunday night at TVB City in Tseung Kwan O. The 26-year-old, contestant number one, received the title from last year's winner, Stacey Devina Chan.

Yuen is a communications graduate of Hong Kong Baptist University who has worked as a theme park performer, stage actor, model and event host. She earlier finished third at Miss Chinese World 2026 in Kuala Lumpur. After the result she said she had not realised the announcement was imminent until her name was called.

Ada Tang Hong-man, 24, a patternmaker's assistant at a haute couture label, was first runner-up. Scarlett Li, 24, an ESG reporting consultant with a master's degree from the Chinese University of Hong Kong, was second runner-up and Miss Photogenic. Chorie Li was named Miss Friendship by her fellow contestants.

Twelve finalists competed under the slogan "Dare To Be Perfect". The last four standing were Yuen, Li, Tang and Jasmine Lo. The final was hosted at TVB City and featured performances with former titleholders and the group MYNT.

zh.headline: 主題樂園演員袁絲珩當選2026香港小姐冠軍
zh.dek: 26歲浸大傳理系畢業生周日晚於將軍澳電視城奪冠，亞軍鄧匡閷、季軍李澤欣。
body: 2026年度香港小姐競選決賽周日晚於將軍澳電視城舉行，1號佳麗袁絲珩奪得冠軍，由上屆冠軍陳曉華為她戴上后冠。本屆為第54屆港姐，口號為「敢 · 至完美」。
現年26歲的袁絲珩畢業於香港浸會大學傳理系，從事主題樂園演員，亦有舞台劇、莫特兒及司儀工作。她較早前代表香港出戰吉隆坡舉行的世界華裔小姐，取得季軍。頒獎後她表示，直至唱名一刻才意會到結果揭曉。
亞軍為24歲的鄧匡閷，任職高級訂製服紙樣助理；季軍李澤欣同樣24歲，為環境、社會及管治報告顧問，持有中文大學碩士學位，並獲頒最上鏡小姐。友誼小姐由佳麗互選，由李澄晴獲得。
決賽共12名佳麗參賽，最後四強為袁絲珩、李澤欣、鄧匡閷及盧蔚晴。台上有歷屆港姐及組合MYNT參與演出。
